messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 6):
"""
6) Cancellation of indemnity based health insurance policy by the policyholder: The policyholder may cancel his/her policy at any time during the term, by giving 7 days notice in writing. The Insurer shall a. refund proportionate premium for unexpired policy period, if the term of policy upto one year and there is no claim (s) made during the policy period. b. refund premium for the unexpired policy period, in respect of policies with term more than 1 year and risk coverage for such policy years has not commenced. 7) Nomination: a. The policyholder shall give his nomination for the purpose of payment of claims. In the event of death of the policyholder, the claim proceeds will be paid to the nominee. b. Nomination can be changed any time during the term of the policy.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

If the policy term is up to one year and no claims have been made, you will receive a refund of the proportionate premium for the unexpired period.","facts":["\"The policyholder may cancel his/her policy at any time during the term, by giving 7 days notice in writing.\"","\"refund proportionate premium for unexpired policy period, if the term of policy upto one year and there is no claim (s) made during the policy period.\""]},{"question":"Can I change my nominee at any time during the policy term?","answer":"Yes, you can change your nominee at any time during the term of the policy.","facts":["\"Nomination can be changed any time during the term of the policy.\""]}]}
